name: React Native (Expo)
subtitle: Cross-platform mobile framework
creator: Meta (Facebook)

version.label: New Architecture by default; Expo SDK recommended

description: Build real native iPhone and Android apps using React and JavaScript or TypeScript. Components map to genuine native views, not a web page in a wrapper. Expo is the recommended way to start: it handles builds, updates and device APIs.
useCases: iOS and Android apps from one codebase
Apps that share logic with a web app

concepts.explanation: Tooling for building, testing and shipping.
Ship JS fixes without a store review.

codeSamples.label: TSX · Expo

pairsWith.reason: Share code with a web app

pros: One codebase for iOS and Android
cons: Some features still need native code
Upgrades used to be painful (Expo helps)

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Publishing costs $99/yr (Apple) and $25 once (Google Play). Expo's build service has free and paid plans.
pricing.usageFee: Store fees: Apple $99/yr, Google Play $25 once
